headline: UK Prime Minister Says Returning to EU Without a Referendum Would Be "Unthinkable"
summary: The British prime minister said a return to the European Union without a referendum would be unthinkable, as recent polls show most Britons favour closer ties with the bloc.
why: UK-EU relations determine trade terms, regulatory alignment and the political risk premium on sterling and UK assets.
original_headline: El primer ministro británico dice que volver a la UE sin un referéndum sería "impensable"
